applicability.execution_path: IDENTICAL, which is why this is proven and not reused. applicability.conditions: Single session, no concurrency, no fault injection, an empty table at the start, and one deliberate crash between the two observations. finding.summary: Committed INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE of OOS-backed rows survived kill -9 of the whole instance and a controlled restart, with every surviving value whole and exact: MD5, octet length, bit length, disk size and a direct SQL equality, on all three rows, plus the absence of the deleted row and a clean checkdb. Judged against an external journal in which all three transactions were acknowledged before the crash, under a durable-commit configuration read back from paramdump rather than assumed. 16 of the case's 17 assertions executed; the seventeenth is debug-only and was recorded as SKIP.
